column1: # Drop-in parity manifest — the significant upstream libraries Unbrowse commits to
# being a TRUE, zero-edit drop-in for, in the upstream's own syntax, attributing them.
# A row is GREEN (in scripts/dropin-parity-gate.sh) only when ALL of:
#   1. the shim package exists (shim_path/package.json)
#   2. its README attributes the upstream (mentions upstream_npm) AND says "drop-in"
#   3. its parity test passes (proves it provides the upstream's public surface)
# Adding a new significant library = adding a row here. The row is RED until its
# drop-in is built to parity — features extend the benchmark. The gate is the
# witness for /jesus-ralph: it exits 0 only when EVERY committed gap is filled.
# Distribution (forking each upstream repo + opening an attributing PR that adds
# Unbrowse as the drop-in) is tracked, honestly, in scripts/dropin-distribution.tsv
# — that is self-asserted, NOT part of this runnable gate.
# columns:  upstream_npm <TAB> unbrowse_shim <TAB> shim_path <TAB> readme <TAB> parity_test
